verdict.rationale: First-party docs show several headless and CI paths. The Credential Broker gives CI/CD and machine workflows short-lived access to secrets, Service Accounts automate secrets management without extra services, and Connect Servers expose a private REST API. These are backed by the scriptable op CLI, packaged in Homebrew, and by Go/JS/Python SDKs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of running headlessly in CI, documented integrations with specific CI platforms (e.g. GitHub Actions or GitLab).
